question: By how much is 65% of 75 greater than (3)/(5) of 55?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Value 1 = 65% of 75 = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

Value 2 = 3/5 of 55 = 3 × 11 = 33

Difference = 48.75 − 33 = 15.75

**∴ The correct answer is 15.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/798edf0520cd6eb9ea44ca612eb6d8ec455974351246e3b5e46583e3a80678ea.png] 

**Given:**

First expression = 65% of 75

Second expression = 3/5 of 55

**Calculations:**

⇒ First value = (65/100) × 75

⇒ First value = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

⇒ Second value = (3/5) × 55

⇒ Second value = 3 × 11 = 33

⇒ Difference = 48.75 − 33

⇒ Difference = 15.75

**∴ The correct answer is 15.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert x% to a fraction, divide x by 100. Example: 65% = 65/100 = 13/20.

Fraction of a Number

The word 'of' in mathematics represents multiplication. (a/b) of N = (a/b) × N.

Decimal Multiplication Trick

Multiply the numbers as whole numbers first, then place the decimal point based on the total decimal places in the factors.</p
